exec: Inspien, a Korean company, bought an 80% stake in the penetration-testing firm Raon Security.
geo_basis: country as stated: Korean companies in a Korean-language report; no city stated
plain: Inspien has acquired 80% of Raon Security, a company that does penetration testing and security consulting. Inspien plans to buy the remaining 20% in stages.
summary: Dailysecu and Etnews report that Inspien acquired 80% of Raon Security, a penetration-testing company. Both say Inspien plans to acquire the remaining 20% in stages depending on business results. According to Etnews, the deal is meant to expand AI-based security diagnostics, including automated vulnerability diagnosis and continuous penetration testing. Neither article gives a price.
title: Inspien acquires 80% of Raon Security, Dailysecu and Etnews report

validation.note: Two independent publishers, Dailysecu and Etnews, each state the 80% acquisition and the plan for the remaining 20%; no company statement page read.
